prompt: A soccer match scene with a red striker kicking a ball toward a goal and a blue goalkeeper diving to block it. The ball is positioned between the striker and the goalkeeper, and the goal is located behind the goalkeeper. On the field, there are two red defenders standing side by side in front of the goal line. There are also some blue forwards near the center line, and their number is one more than the number of red defenders. A yellow referee is running alongside the defenders while holding a whistle. A green coach is standing on the sideline next to a substitutions board, pointing at the players. The coach is taller than the substitutions board. Near the coach on the sideline, there are some water bottles, and their number is twice the number of red defenders. A flag is planted at the corner of the field. The defenders are between the striker and the goal. A linesman holding a flag is on the opposite sideline from the coach. A spectator is standing behind the sideline.
